name: Net2RF Bracelet Follow
author: Mike Neiderhauser
description: Drives a Net2RF bracelet controller from the colours of your other props: each controller zone follows one or more FPP models (average, dominant, brightest or one pixel), smoothed and rate-limited to suit the radio, sent over DDP.

privacy.summary: Sends colour data (DDP) to the one Net2RF controller you set, on your network. Nothing else leaves this device.

sends.to: the Net2RF controller address you enter
sends.what: the zone colours, as DDP packets
sends.why: that is how the controller is driven

privacy.other: Settings are kept in config/plugin.fpp-net2rf.json under /home/fpp/media and are not removed on uninstall.
